title: ConsignmentOverview
description: Consignment overview interface for listing operations (supports both v1 and v2 payloads).

id.description: A unique record id for this supply chain consignment in AIG.

aigId.description: The AIG vertex id for this consignment.

identifier.description: Unique identifier representing the consignment in supply chain.

globalId.description: Unique globalId identifier representing the consignment in supply chain.

firstConsignor.description: The first consignor of the consignment, which is the party that initially sent the goods.

lastConsignee.description: The last consignee of the consignment

tradeParty.description: The import and exporter of the consignment

carrierParty.description: The carrier party responsible for the consignment

reference.description: Reference field for the goods load (v2).

transportMeans.description: Details of the transport means used for the consignment

dateCreated.description: The date when this entry was created.

dateUpdated.description: The date when this entry was updated.

payloadVersion.description: Payload version (v1 for Consignment, v2 for GoodsLoad).
